moni.quest.039F70814051413E.description3: Tier Six Microminers are the first option to get some eggs (enough for this quest, as it happens). Later on, you'll also get a much better mission for them using a &6Tier Eight Microminer&r.
moni.quest.08948A23B3A17923.description1: &bLaserIO&r's energy cards can be upgraded with &6Energy Overclockers&r to allow them to transport energy. &eNote that only the extracting card requires an overclocker!&r
moni.quest.09C0CDC1DFA7842D.description1: &2Pumps are useful for gathering Oil or perhaps Lava from the Nether.
moni.quest.0C10EC03A01E7334.description5: The exact implementation is up to you. Make use of the various LV and MV machines you have, and look through &bEMI&r and the Renewable Production tab for the ways to get infinite sources of each ingredient (like &aEnderman Models&r for pearls).
moni.quest.05F7C3F397B329F5.description1: With two &9IV &6Energy Hatches&r on a &3Large Chemical Bath&r, you are now able to break down &6Rarest Metal Mixture&r, which you have been getting from your pre-existing Platline.
moni.quest.1175ED9EF0AB82F6.description7: &9Building Gadgets can be bound to the ME system by &8Shift-right-clicking&9 with it on an online ME Wireless Access Point.&r
moni.quest.1229234A71CE0A99.description1: &6Redstone&f: Found only deep in the world, in massive veins paired with &6Cinnabar&f and &6Ruby&f.

moni.quest.1BADB230EB1BEA4D.description3: Plutonium 241 can be obtained from centrifuging Plutonium 239 dust. Later on, you can also obtain it through a &6MKII Fusion Reactor&r
moni.quest.1BC6DDC2D50F9C46.description2: Since smelting &6Aluminium&r requires MV power, you're going to have to power this with 2 LV Energy Input Hatches.
moni.quest.1C861E0C62D5B97D.description1: Imbue your factory with the Wisdom of the Universe by running the &3ORB&r: While this multiblock is active, all your data access hatches will act like they have every research data available to them! &9One could even break causality with this technology...&r
moni.quest.1EA5F30C5ACADBA9.description3: Note that the above behavior is specific to Normal microverses. &eEach microverse type repairs in different ways&r, so make sure to ready their quests!
moni.quest.22E50A6923EBF5CB.description3: Your first neutronium will be obtained from the &6T8 Microminer&r or &3Mk3 Fusion Reactor&r.
moni.quest.22E50A6923EBF5CB.description4: Later on, you might consider using &6T9 Microminers&r or &3Naquadah Chemistry&r to boost your neutronium production.
moni.quest.2BBAF93506DD79C1.description2: With &9RF Cards&r and &3Energy Converters&r in this pack, this probably has limited use, but you can build it if you want. &2Notably, you can use an Active Transformer to interface with your Power Substation if you run out of hatch space.&r
moni.quest.2D10F2E538486624.description4: Each &aEnergy Hatch&r increases the reactor's power buffer. &cYou cannot use 4x or 16x Energy Hatches in Fusion Reactors. &aAll 16 Energy Hatches&r are required to be able to process all Mark 1 recipes and give a power buffer of &e160M EU&r. &2However, not all energy hatches need to be connected to power. For example, a recipe that requires LuV power draw would only need one or more hatches connected to power, but a recipe that needs ZPM power draw would need at least two hatches connected to power.&r &cThey still need to be present on the structure!&r
moni.quest.2D10F2E538486624.description8: Fusion Reactors &2overclock, but only once per fusion tier, instead of based on energy input.&r They gate the next tier of materials, so you will eventually want to make more than one.
moni.quest.38B1588655AA9BDF.description2: Shattered microverses cannot be repaired in any way. To run more missions, you must re-shatter a Normal microverse. When a Shattered microverse reaches 0% Integrity, it becomes a &3Corrupted Microverse&r.

moni.quest.485CEA4199AAD352.description3: HASoC chips grant access to cheaper &6Wetware Processors&r, but require a &3Circuit Assembler&r running &4UHV&r voltage.
moni.quest.4E4F03C44623A85D.description2: For every Hatch it has, its buffer increases by 80M EU, up to a maximum of 1280M.
moni.quest.59219D37B5CE80E6.description1:
Imagine if we could sandwich all of the strongest Microminer platings together with some &6Monium&r, creating something truly impossible and incredible. 

&9If only we had the knowledge to be able to assemble something like that...&r
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description1: Unlike &aRF power&r, which is safe to transport with &bLaserIO&r, &aEU power &erequires caution&r. The key is to always &amatch or exceed&r the &eVoltage &rand&e Amperage&r of your power source with your &6cables&r and machines.
Transporting &aEU power &erequires caution&r. The key is to always &amatch or exceed&r the &eVoltage &rand&e Amperage&r of your power source with your &6cables&r and machines.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description2: &cNEVER &rhook up your Energy Converter&r to a cable that has fewer &eAmps&r than your Energy Converter or Battery Buffer generates. For example, you must use &64x cable&r for a 4A Converter&r, and &616x cable&r for a filled 16-slot Battery Buffer&r. Cables with insufficient amperage rating will &cburn and be destroyed&r.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description3: Similarly, your cable must match or exceed the &eVoltage&r of your machines, or they will &cburn and be destroyed&r.
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description4: &cNEVER&r connect a machine to excessive &eVoltage&r or it will &cvaporize&r. Touching a &6wire&r with connected &aEU power&r will &cinjure or kill you&r, so for your safety, &euse &6cables&e instead&r!
moni.quest.5A94534682807314.description5: &2Superconductor-type wires do not damage you in GTm. The 0-loss wires (Conductive Iron, Energetic Alloy, etc.) are considered Superconductors.
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description1: &6Wrought Iron&r is a better alternative than &6Iron&r for tools, and with the &3Alloy Smelter&r you finally have a way to manufacture it, albeit slowly.
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description2: First, you put Iron Ingots the &3Alloy Smelter&r with a &6Nugget Mold&r to create Iron Nuggets. Those Nuggets are then smelted in any &3Furnace&r to create &6Wrought Iron Nuggets.&r
moni.quest.70784021A2D4E520.description3: Finally, you can turn those &6Wrought Iron Nuggets&r into a &6Wrought Iron Ingot&r with another trip to the &3Alloy Smelter,&r or by &3Macerating&r them, combining the dust piles and another round of smelting in a &3Furnace.&r
moni.quest.738A141D31AD7CE3.description2: These cores require &6Omnium&r and &6Neutronium&r and must be filled with &6Hadal Sculk&r.
moni.quest.74A7ABF43D6A403F.description2: It is important to note that if you do not have the required hatches, the Terminal will leave holes for those hatches, causing the multiblock to not form.
moni.quest.7C5CE283172CD952.description3: Frequencies are distinguished based on a 8 character hexadecimal color code. Optionally, you can give each frequency a description. In the top left of the link's GUI, you can find a button leading to a menu with a list of all available frequencies and their descriptions.
moni.quest.7C5CE283172CD952.description4: There are a limited number of available frequencies, so try to keep the number of fluid links below 16,777,216.
moni.quest.7C89BC235C988689.description3: It is recommended to use the &3Energetic Infuser&r from &bThermal Series&r to charge the cores. With the proper &6integral components&r and &6augments&r, the Infuser can operate at incredible speeds.
moni.quest.3E1A349F989835F7.description1:
It is easier to explain how &6Photonic Chips&r work in text rather than visually.

Imagine each Chip has three on/off levers for the Red, Green, and Blue colors. When a Chip is put into the Crucible, the lever(s) corresponding to the Crucible's colors are toggled. Secondary colors flip both of their primary components' levers.

For example, a Red Chip put into a green Crucible would output a Yellow Chip, because the green color flipped the green 'lever' on.
A magenta Chip put into a cyan Crucible would output a Yellow Chip, because the cyan color toggled both the blue lever Off and the green lever On.

In either case, the Crucible will be left in the state corresponding to the Chip's color &3at recipe start&r, or to the next primary color clockwise if the Chip was inert.
moni.quest.3E1A349F989835F7.title: Photonic Chips
moni.quest.3E1A349F989835F7.description2: When a PSoC is put into the Crucible, the lever(s) corresponding to the Crucible's colors are toggled. Secondary colors flip both of their primary components' levers. Afterwards, the Crucible changes color to what the PSoC previously was.
